name: Implicit Voxel Simplification with Error Metric
definition: A simplification algorithm operating on voxels that approximates the surface implicitly by defining a hierarchy of function values, coarsening voxels where the function is smooth enough according to a novel error metric.
summary: Implicit Voxel Simplification with Error Metric coarsens implicit voxel models by minimizing approximation error of the signed distance field to preserve the zero-level set surface geometry.
